raw_segments.text: Cornwall, this is some fellow who, having been praised for bluntness, doth affect a
saucy roughness, and constrains the garb quite from his nature.
He cannot flatter, he, an honest mind and plain, he must speak truth.
And they will take it, so, if not, he's plain.
These kind of knaves I know which in this plainness harbor more craft and more corruptor
ends than twenty silly ducking observance that stretch their duties nicely.
